rounds.text: ADC India Communications Ltd demonstrates exceptional capital efficiency and financial quality that distinguishes it from sector peers. The company commands an extraordinary return on capital employed of 31.18% alongside a median return on equity of 30% over the last three years, vastly outperforming the sector median ROCE of 9.2% [E10, E28, E75]. This superior profitability is underpinned by a pristine balance sheet featuring a debt-to-equity ratio of -0.00x, allowing the business to operate virtually debt-free while generating Rs 13 Cr in operating and free cash flow in March 2026 [E35, E36, E38, E58]. Growth metrics further reinforce this operational strength, highlighted by a 39% compounded profit growth rate over five years and robust recent sales expansion that propelled the rules-based screen to score the company an 82 out of 100 with a BUY signal [E19, E64, E65]. Market momentum mirrors these underlying fundamentals, as evidenced by a 100 relative-strength rating against the Nifty 500 and an 85.6% twelve-month price return [E50, E51]. conceded: [E44, E46].

While the bull champions an extraordinary ROCE of 31.18% and a three-year median ROE of 30% [E10, E28], these high returns sit on a stretched valuation of 51.1x P/E and an 11.19x price-to-book multiple that outpaces the sector benchmark of 4.85x [E1, E2, E7]. The pristine balance sheet and debt-free status [E38, E58] do not excuse the fact that compounding profit growth over the trailing twelve months has dropped to -23% [E21], while debtor days have worsened from 66.4 to 81.7 days [E63]. Conceded: [E10, E28, E38, E50, E51, E58]. The DCF intrinsic value of Rs 1,682 against a market price of Rs 2,103 confirms a negative margin of safety of -25.1% [E44, E45], and the reverse DCF reveals the stock already prices in a 21.1% earnings growth rate [E46].
